$schema.binary: executable name, and the ~/.superset/bin wrapper name
$schema.args: argv that puts that CLI into ACP mode
$schema.minVersion: lowest version these args are known to work with; 0.0.0 is ungated
$schema.adapter: npm package that translates ACP for a CLI that cannot speak it
$schema.executableEnv: env var that adapter reads to find the CLI
$schema.upgrade: command shown to a reader whose CLI is missing or too old
$schema.note: evidence for minVersion; lowering one needs a verified handshake

claude-acp.note: 2.1.226 verified against adapter 0.85.0: session/new returns the same modes and configOptions as 2.1.286.

codex-acp.note: Conservative: the adapter drives `codex app-server`, and the release that introduced it is not pinned. Latest at authoring time; lower it once an older version is verified.

gemini-acp.note: Conservative. `--acp` replaced `--experimental-acp`, and the rename release is not pinned beyond being above 0.20.0, which defined only the experimental spelling. Sending `--acp` to a CLI that predates it prints usage and exits 0, which reads as a crash, so the floor errs high.

opencode-acp.note: 1.15.5 verified: initialize reports OpenCode 1.15.5 and session/new returns a session with model options.

pi-acp.note: Ungated: no pi install was available to verify a floor against, and gating on a guess would reject working versions. It reached the same state before this catalogue, since the harness resolved pi off PATH either way.
